claims.limitation: Root cause could be capacity, feed format incompatibility, or scheduling mismatch

claims.statement: East-node carrier system may be at or exceeding capacity due to concentrated v18 split-reservation order load

next_action.rationale: Perfect correlation between EXC-0921 and held orders indicates v18 created a load pattern the system can't handle. East-node dock capacity is the most likely physical constraint. Checking dock utilization, available slots, and queue depth will determine if this is a capacity-based root cause or if we need to investigate feed compatibility or carrier pickup scheduling defect.
